summary: The bar just under the address bar where you can pin bookmarks for quick access.
description: PlacesToolbar (extends PlacesViewBase) is a plain JS view class, not a custom element; it is manually instantiated by browser-places.js as `new PlacesToolbar(...)` against the existing #PlacesToolbarItems/#PersonalToolbar markup and attached as `_placesView`, handling rendering, drag-and-drop, overflow chevron, and resize behavior for the bookmarks toolbar.
